candidate_ideas.name: Portable Path Auditor
candidate_ideas.pain: These defects often remain invisible until checkout on another operating system.
candidate_ideas.problem: Repository paths can collide on case-insensitive systems or use Windows-reserved names.
candidate_ideas.solution: A local CLI that audits real paths for portability hazards without modifying them.
candidate_ideas.verification: Fixture repositories exercise collisions, reserved names, and clean trees.

candidate_ideas.name: CSV Contract Probe
candidate_ideas.pain: Downstream scripts fail late or ingest malformed data.
candidate_ideas.problem: Incoming CSV files silently change columns or primitive value shapes.
candidate_ideas.solution: A local CLI that infers a compact schema and compares files against a saved contract.
candidate_ideas.verification: Automated fixtures cover schema creation, matching input, and drift.

candidate_ideas.name: Text Hygiene Scanner
candidate_ideas.pain: The defects are hard to spot visually and often spread through edits.
candidate_ideas.problem: Mixed line endings and trailing whitespace cause noisy diffs and tooling failures.
candidate_ideas.solution: A read-only CLI that locates exact files and lines with text hygiene defects.
candidate_ideas.verification: Fixtures cover CRLF mixing, trailing whitespace, binary exclusion, and clean files.
